text:
Marta: Quick recap from NovaRep onboarding call — they flagged 3 items that are blocking procurement sign-off for renewal: 1) CSV of onboarding errors + transcript counts for last 60 days, 2) a small Console view showing "seat usage by route" for their billing team, 3) an enablement playbook + 15m walk-through for their finance and ops teams.
Evan: Can you paste the exact fields legal asked for?
Marta: Legal wants raw lines for audit: route, event_type (request|response|error), prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, transcript_length_chars, user_email (redact ok), recorded_at. They prefer CSV delivered via presigned S3 link.
Ravi: We can build the export from events_stream. Quick note: need to redact emails and PII, and rate-limit the export job to avoid load. Also want to avoid exporting raw transcripts; we'll instead include transcript_length_chars only.
Priya: For enablement I'll draft a 1-pager mapping CSV fields to their GL account codes and a 15m session. If we provide a Console view, that's ideal for non-technical finance.
Evan: Short-term plan: Ravi to drop a redacted CSV to an S3 bucket and share pre-signed link. Medium: product to scope a Console per-route seat view + downloadable export.
Marta: NovaRep said renewal meeting is in 11 business days. They said procurement won't sign until legal has that CSV. If we miss it, they may pause expansion. Risk: high.
Ravi: I'll run an export job tomorrow with the following query and a sed redaction step. Will tag infra for safe window.
Ravi: ```bash
# redacted audit export (60d)
psql events -c "COPY (SELECT route, event_type, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, char_length(transcript) AS transcript_length_chars, user_email, recorded_at FROM events_raw WHERE recorded_at >= now() - interval '60 days') TO STDOUT WITH CSV HEADER" | sed -E 's/[^,]+@[^,]+/REDACTED_EMAIL/g' | cut -d',' -f1-5,7 > novarep_audit_60d.csv
```
Priya: Nice. For the Console change, can product ship a minimal MVP: a table at /console/account/<account>/routes with columns route, seats_allocated, tokens_last_30d, avg_latency? We can hide tokens if needed for privacy and only enable export for admins.
Evan: Acceptance criteria for product backlog: (a) Console route table visible to account admins, (b) CSV export button that triggers a presigned S3 link with TTL, (c) audit CSV schema documented, (d) role-based access control. Low-effort UI + API.
Marta: Action items: 1) Ravi to produce redacted CSV and S3 presigned link by Tue EOD. 2) Priya to prepare the 1-pager and schedule 15m walkthrough with NovaRep. 3) Evan to open product ticket and tag security for RBAC and export controls. I'll confirm timeline with the customer.
CS-Bot: Reminder — NovaRep renewal check-in scheduled in 11 business days (invite updated).
Priya: I'll also record the walkthrough and attach a template email for finance.
Evan: I'll add a sample curl to generate presigned link in the ticket so ops can reuse it:
Evan: ```bash
# example presign (ops)
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-exports/novarep_audit_60d.csv --expires-in 604800
```
Marta: Thanks team. I'll update NovaRep after the CSV drop.
Ravi: pinging infra now to reserve a low-traffic window.
Priya: :raised_hands:
